purpose: Bounded official-source review registry, separate from the version-matching operator CatalogManifest.
publication_state: reference-only; not approved, installed, indexed, or eligible for automatic dependency matching
coverage_policy: Each entry covers only its enumerated pages/topics. Rolling paths record observed bytes, never exact package coverage. Linked pages, includes, API directives, tabs and client-rendered content are not recursively expanded.

fetch_policy.network: HTTPS public publisher URLs only; no credentials, queries, fragments or recursive crawl
fetch_policy.retention: Documentation metadata, body hashes and parser counts only; bounded robots policy snapshots retained to reproduce permissions. No documentation bodies vendored.
